data.title: Can President Trump’s crypto dinner spark a breakout on the memecoin’s charts?
data.description:
The infamous President Donald Trump crypto dinners are back. The next one, dubbed the Gala Dinner, will be held on 22nd November. It will be the third crypto dinner and will be held at the Trump National Golf Club in Washington. 

The crypto holders, especially his “fans,” who are the top 185 holders of his Official Trump [TRUMP] memecoin, will be granted first access. President Trump had previously stated that he would be at the event. 

Two other events will be extended to TRUMP holders, but the President won’t attend them. One of the events, the F1 Singapore Grand Prix, is reserved only for the top 23 TRUMP holders between 18th July and 5th October. 

The final event will be Super Bowl LXI, but the details are yet to be publicized. These events are run by Fight Fight Fight LLC, a firm registered in Delaware and it is jointly controlled by Trump’s CIC Digital LLC and Celebration Cards. 

For the Gala Dinner, the event promises,

The most exclusive dinner in the world. An evening with 3 legends and President Donald Trump, plus a private meet and greet with a legend to be announced.

The VIP list will be the top 29, with the top 4 TRUMP holders expected to receive 18-karat Trump-branded gold watches. 

Will Trump crypto dinners boost the memecoin?

It’s not clear how much the top 185 holders will spend to get into the event. However, the event will likely spark another backlash from Democrats. 

Notably, similar Trump crypto dinners in April and May 2025 faced massive opposition, with Democrats slamming them as an “orgy of corruption.”

According to Public Citizen, a public watchdog, Trump’s crypto ventures made $1.4B in profits in 2025. Over half of the windfall, $635M, was generated by the TRUMP memecoin. 

On the contrary, Trump crypto investors made a massive $4.7B loss, mainly driven by TRUMP ($3.2B) and World Liberty Financial’s WLFI token ($1B). Put differently, as Trump pocketed a +$600M profit in the TRUMP memecoin, holders lost 5x more than his gains. 

These crypto dealings have forced Democrats to withhold support for the CLARITY Act, a crucial crypto bill. They are now calling for a strict ethics provision to address the alleged corruption by the Trump family.

Worth noting though that TRUMP’s value tripled in Q3 2026, jumping from $1.4 to $3.6. However, it also erased some gains, dipping by 42% to $2.1. It has been consolidating between $1.8 and $2.2 since. As it stands, it’s unclear whether the Gala Dinner will help it break above the range. 

Final Summary

  • Trump will hold another Gala Dinner with the top 185 holders of his memecoin in November.
  • The TRUMP memecoin is stuck within the $1.8-$2.2 price range ahead of the dinner.

data.title: Dogecoin price stalls below $0.10 as DogeOS opens DeFi testnet
data.description:
Dogecoin [DOGE] remained below the $0.10 price level even as developers introduced a new way to build applications around the memecoin.

DogeOS public testnet is now open, allowing developers to experiment with payments, trading, lending, games, and other services that use DOGE. But the new development has not led to a positive impact on the coin’s price.

DogeOS brings new uses to Dogecoin

DogeOS announced that its testnet was open to developers on September 30.

The project said teams were already developing different products.

Transactions on the test network use test DOGE for fees. But the key thing here is that the currency has no market value and can be obtained through a faucet provided for developers.

DogeOS could eventually give DOGE more uses beyond payments and trading. But it is important to note that the project is different from Dogecoin itself.

The testnet is a different application layer built around Dogecoin; it is not an upgrade to Dogecoin’s main blockchain.

DOGE remains trapped below $0.10

The launch comes as DOGE trades near the $0.095 price level; it is up less than 1% at the time of this writing.

Although the price response was not a lot, DOGE remained above several levels that previously held it back. This means that the buyers have taken back some control after the price recovered from its August lows.

The more difficult test now sits at the $0.10 price level. DOGE briefly moved above that level in September, but it was not able to stay there. If it is able to move beyond that level, it could open the door to the recent high near $0.105.

For now, the area between the $0.092 and $0.093 price levels is where the nearest support is. This is where buyers may try to stop it from falling further. If it loses that range, it could fall toward the $0.087 price level.

The testnet provides Dogecoin with a fresh development story, but it seems traders are waiting to see stronger evidence of adoption.

Final Summary

  • DogeOS has opened a public testnet for different applications.DOGE remains below the $0.10 price level, with support showing around the $0.092–$0.093 price levels.

data.title: JASMY gained 15% – But Smart Money isn’t buying it
data.description:
JasmyCoin [JASMY] has gained traction, with gains reaching roughly 15% in the past day, while exchange activities have played a significant role in driving the asset’s value upward.

The positioning in the market is now gradually changing, and the asset is likely to witness a downturn that could weigh on the accumulated gains from bulls in the market in the near term.

JASMY gains as market volume surges

The gain in JASMY has been driven by momentum in the market, with volume growing significantly alongside price, a classic bullish setup.

The volume across the market has surged by 48% to $68 million. Volume and price surging at the same time often reflect ongoing buying activity in the market.

While the volume has surged, the activity has been bullish across the majority of the market exchanges, particularly Binance, Bybit, KuCoin, and Gate, where the majority of the volume is long volume.

For example, on Binance, the Long to Short Ratio, which records all the activity across accounts on the platform, stood at 1.58, with top traders being the most bullish at 1.83 on the chart.

Whenever the Long/Short Ratio has a reading above 1, it suggests there is more bullish volume in the market, and investors are likely to continue pushing the asset’s volume higher.

Open Interest and Funding Rate support bullish momentum

The market analysis shows that there has been a growing inflow of capital into the perpetual market, and traders have positioned it largely for a long-term rally.

The Open Interest, which records capital in the market, was valued at $35.24 million following a 30% surge in the market. This implies that roughly $10.57 million of fresh capital entered JASMY’s perpetual market within that period over the past 24 hours.

The bullish outcome came from the fact that traders positioned the capital for a long, with the Funding Rate turning positive within that period.

CoinGlass data shows that the Funding Rate had reached 0.0183% at the time of this report, suggesting that traders are expecting the asset to surge further in the near term.

Notably, the inflow, as well as the positive Funding Rate, has been moderate at the time of writing, suggesting that the market outlook is likely to maintain its current outlook.

Smart Money turns bearish as selling pressure rises

The major concern for now has been the positioning of Smart Money, which has now opposed the ongoing trend.

Smart Money, which often makes profitable bets on the asset whether they go long or short, is presently bearish on the asset, as they anticipate the asset declining.

In the Spot market, there has been profit-taking activity, with $3.79 million sold in the market compared to the purchased asset. The netflow presently sits at $412,710 at the time of this writing.

When there is a massive outflow like this, especially one that has lasted for days, the selling pressure becomes more significant. For context, in this case, there has been more selling over the last 30 days. Continued selling could significantly weigh on the asset’s near-term performance.

Final Summary

  • JASMY gained 15% as rising volume, Open Interest, and positive Funding Rate supported bullish momentum.
  • Smart Money turned bearish, while continued Spot selling could weigh on JASMY’s near-term performance.

data.title: Illinois crypto tax faces six-month delay as state agrees to injunction
data.description:
Illinois officials have agreed to support a six-month delay to the state’s incoming digital asset tax while a court considers whether the law is constitutional.

The tax was scheduled to take effect on January 1, 2027. Under a joint court request, enforcement would instead begin on 1 July, but that is provided the judge approves the agreement.

Illinois crypto tax heads back to court

The Digital Chamber and Illinois Blockchain Association filed the lawsuit against the Illinois Department of Revenue and state Attorney General Kwame Raoul.

Their case challenges the Digital Asset Tax Act, which introduces a 0.2% tax on certain digital asset transactions involving a fee.

On October 1, both sides submitted an agreed motion asking the Sangamon County Circuit Court to pause implementation for six months.

The Digital Chamber described the development as an agreement by Illinois to delay the tax. 

The pause would become effective only when the judge enters the order.

Illinois officials must respond to the amended complaint by November 13. The additional time would allow the court to consider the legal arguments before businesses have to collect or pay the tax.

Why crypto groups are challenging the law

The groups argue that Illinois has singled out digital assets for treatment that does not apply equally to other similar financial transactions.

They also claim the law could affect businesses and users outside Illinois, and this could potentially interfere with trade between states.

Other things they pointed out included due process, penalties, and Illinois’s restriction on taxing personal property according to its value. The plaintiffs also argued that the tax was in conflict with federal rules that were intended to prevent discriminatory taxation of online commerce.

Illinois disputes those allegations.

The temporary pause was agreed, but state officials did not say that the tax was unlawful. Both sides await as the court considers the case.

If it is approved, it would offer temporary relief to exchanges and other parties that will be affected by the new law.

Final Summary

  • Illinois and crypto industry groups jointly requested a six-month delay to the state’s digital asset tax.
  • The agreement will not start until the court enters the injunction, and the wider lawsuit remains unresolved.

data.title: Muneeb Ali is back as Stacks Labs CEO after 5 years: STX jumps over 28%
data.description:
Stacks founder Muneeb Ali is returning as Stacks Labs CEO, opening a new leadership chapter centered on growing Bitcoin-based financial infrastructure.

Muneeb will be replacing interim CEO Alex Miller, who is shifting into an advisory role following his role in establishing Stacks Labs.

This leadership transition comes as Stacks shifts its focus towards adoption after completing various key infrastructure milestones.

Ali returns with institutional expansion in focus

The Stacks network already collaborates with 21Shares, UTXO Management, HashKey Cloud, Anchorage Digital, and Fireblocks as far as Bitcoin staking is concerned.

Additionally, the Genesis Bond was launched with 250 BTC from four institutions, reinforcing Stacks’ push into institutional Bitcoin products.

Anchorage Digital furthermore recently introduced custody infrastructure in support of BTC-denominated rewards while the principal remains on Bitcoin L1.

Beyond institutional adoption, the incoming CEO also identified 100x capacity, institutional-grade privacy, and post-quantum development among his top priorities as he took over his new position.

Ali noted on an X post that he will be working alongside CTO Adriano Di Luzio and the wider team on these important initiatives.

Stacks is also extending institutional engagement across Hong Kong, Korea, and the larger Middle East with the broader objective of bringing more Bitcoin capital into applications built around Stacks.

STX surges 28.8% after Ali’s return

Stacks’ [STX] price responded sharply after news emerged that Ali would return to lead Stacks Labs. Notably, the token surged 28.8% over 24 hours, reaching approximately $0.4039 during the rapid rally.

The rapid move was majorly centered on the renewed attention surrounding Ali’s leadership and Stacks’ plans for its next major development phase.

Additionally, the response was also attributed to the discussion around Bitcoin’s expanding application layer, which renewed attention across the market.

Ultimately, the new leadership transition now puts the institutional expansion, greater network capacity, and Bitcoin-native applications at the center of STX’s next chapter.

Final Summary

  • Muneeb Ali’s return puts institutional expansion and Bitcoin infrastructure back at Stacks’ center.
  • STX jumped 28.8% as investors responded to the renewed leadership and development roadmap.

data.title: XLM price prediction – Why Stellar’s $0.21 rebound could trigger a 9% rally
data.description:
Stellar’s XLM, like the rest of the altcoin market, gave back part of its recent gains. It fell about 9% from the Q3 high of $0.23 to a low of $0.21. However, it tagged a short-term support level that has seen a spike in demand and could reverse the recent decline and offer a 9% gain. 

XLM price extends uptrend momentum

On the price charts, the altcoin was already up 4% after defending the range low of the rising channel (blue). 

In the past two weeks, XLM has been making higher lows and higher highs, printing the rising channel pattern. Simply put, the altcoin uptrend momentum has been steadily rising.  

For traders, the channel’s range lows and highs have offered trading opportunities since mid-September. If the trend extends, XLM could target the range high ($0.25). That would translate to a 14% potential upside if hit. 

But it must first clear the recent price high of $0.23 and the mid-channel range. If the immediate hurdle is hit, that would be a 9% gain from the $0.21 support. 

At press time, the Relative Strength Index (RSI) was above the neutral line, further suggesting there was more room for an upside move. 

The short-term bullish outlook would be invalidated in case of a bearish breakout below the rising channel. Such a move would open a downside risk scenario to $0.20. 

Whale activity could fuel XLM price recovery

That said, the liquidation heatmap showed an upside pool right below $0.24, which aligned with the mid-channel range and $0.23 level mentioned above. 

As such, in case of volatility-driven market swings, the target could be reached, further reinforcing the bullish thesis and 9% potential gain. 

Besides, CryptoQuant indicated a spike in whale buying during the recent pullback. The renewed whale interest could help the altcoin defend the range lows and boost the uptrend. 

Overall, the fact that the recent 4% rebound was also being driven by spot bidding by whales could bolster bulls’ push to $0.23 or higher. But a breach below the short-term rising channel would be a warning sign of building selling pressure, effectively invalidating the bullish thesis. 

Final Summary

  • Stellar’s XLM defended its short-term support above $0.21 amid whale spot bids 
  • The recovery gain could extend to 9-14% if XLM maintains its short-term trend

data.title: Bitcoin clears $85K, but is ‘Uptober’ setting up a bull trap?
data.description:
The “Uptober” frenzy is taking off across the market.

From a technical point of view, BTC’s 42% Q3 rally is already positioning for a better Q4. For BTC, Q4 has historically been one of its strongest quarters, with an average quarterly ROI in excess of 70%. However, for history to repeat itself, October will be crucial in setting the tone for BTC’s Q4 momentum.

This is where the chart below becomes important. According to Glassnode, the sell wall above BTC has largely disappeared. Buyers took out the $85K wall yesterday after nearly a week of failed attempts. So, with less near-term liquidity sitting above BTC, the road higher could also be relatively easy, allowing for the price to move faster if buying takes off.

Notably, the macro setup could also support this move.

As per FedWatch data, rate hike odds dropped from 70% to 26% as expectations of a pause increased. This implies that the market may be slowly starting to price a more liquidity-friendly setup. Up until the recent macro releases, the market was cautious on Bitcoin, with macro FUD acting a key hurdle. Now, with that pressure easing, improving liquidity expectations could give Bitcoin room to extend its momentum.

Interestingly, the momentum seems to be picking up already too. According to CoinGlass, Bitcoin’s long/short ratio was once again above 1. This hinted at an increase in long positioning by traders. So, with the macro FUD easing, liquidity expectations increasing, and the sell wall thinning out, is Bitcoin [BTC] finally gearing up for its “Uptober” momentum?

Is Bitcoin’s $85K breakout a bull trap?

Bitcoin’s ongoing chop could be either accumulation or another fakeout.

While liquidity expectations are improving, the improvement has not been reflected in strong spot buying. U.S Spot Bitcoin ETFs closed September in the red, ending a nine-day inflow streak with $3.1 billion. The funds recorded $148.7 million in net outflows on Wednesday, with Fidelity’s FBTC leading the exits with $125.6 million, while BlackRock’s IBIT saw $9.5 million in outflows, ending its own nine-day inflow streak.

Now, the key question is whether this is the start of sustained outflows. While it’s still too early to confirm a trend, further outflows in this area may put further pressure on Bitcoin. $136.72 million in BTC spot sell orders are stacked between $89K-$109K on Coinbase. This overhead supply could act as resistance if spot buying remains weak, making it harder for Bitcoin to sustain its breakout.

Additionally, the outflows occurred just as rate cut expectations were cooling down, pointing to institutions still not fully pricing in an easier liquidity environment. This, in contrast to the bullish positioning in the Futures market, carving a discrepancy between the spot demand and the derivatives sentiment.

If this situation persists, Bitcoin’s $85K breakout will struggle to sustain itself.

With ETF flows turning red and sell orders building up above, the breakout still needs stronger spot demand to confirm the move. Otherwise, the recent move above $85K can turn into a fakeout, catching late bulls off guard and undermining Bitcoin’s early “Uptober” momentum.

Final Summary

  • Low selling and improving liquidity could push Bitcoin higher.
  • Weak ETF flows and heavy sell orders could turn the $85K breakout into a fakeout.

data.title: Can AAVE crypto reach $200? THIS overbought signal raises concerns
data.description:
Aave [AAVE] might be closing in on a solid profit-taking setup.

From a technical standpoint, the altcoin is up over 20% this week, and is among the top performers in the weekly ranking. The price of AAVE crypto climbed back to where it was at the beginning of January as it rose above $180 to bring both long- and short-term players closer to breakeven. With technicals now overbought, the push towards $200 could see more profit-taking pressure if momentum begins to slow down.

Moreover, with AAVE/BTC up 10%+ this month, it has gained ground for the fourth consecutive week, which suggests that AAVE’s 60%+ rally is not just on the back of the broader market, but also due to strength relative to Bitcoin [BTC]. So, with AAVE/BTC extended, any loss of momentum could increase the risk of a pullback.

In essence, AAVE’s move toward $200 doesn’t look like a straight-line rally.

The main question is what is fueling AAVE crypto’s upside. As mentioned above, more than 60% of its monthly gains are coming from rotational flows, meaning that capital moving from BTC to AAVE appears to be a critical factor. 

So, if BTC.D breaks out and capital starts flowing back to BTC, could that put pressure on AAVE crypto? From a technical perspective, a change in flows could reduce AAVE/BTC momentum and make the path to $200 more challenging, especially with the altcoin already looking stretched.

AAVE crypto’s on-chain momentum puts fuel to the rally

AAVE’s on-chain setup could be giving a different perspective.

In a post on X, the company announced that Aave saw $1.1 trillion in borrow volume. Thus, the demand for lending services on the platform appears to be robust, while its technicals appear to be stretched.

What can support this view is the chart below. According to DeFiLlama data, AAVE crypto closed last month with on-chain figures returning to where they were seen in early June. TVL peaked at almost $20 million, up 18% from the previous month, while fees crossed $37 million, climbing 15% from the same period last year.

Taken together, these figures confirm that Aave’s on-chain activity is growing. The increased TVL speaks of inflows of capital into the platform, and the increasing fees demonstrate the strong lending demand. In other words, the rise in AAVE’s price is justified by its actual usage on-chain.

That makes AAVE’s current upside more than just rotational flows from Bitcoin.

With strong network demand, steady capital flows, and positive technical momentum, AAVE could continue to outperform Bitcoin in the near term, keeping the $200 target in focus.

Final Summary

  • AAVE’s strong rally could push it toward $200, but overbought conditions may trigger profit-taking.
  • Rising TVL, fees, and lending demand show that AAVE’s on-chain activity is also growing.

data.title: XRP’s $1.54 breakout test meets Ripple’s 1B token unlock – Can demand absorb supply?
data.description:
XRP price action is tightening within a narrowing structure as buyers defend rising support while sellers continue capping rebounds. After reaching $1.665, Ripple [XRP] fell and continued to form lower highs towards $1.55.

The rising support defended each of the declines from about $1.45-$1.47. This keeps the short-term recovery shape alive and well. XRP currently trades at approximately $1.4916, close to the bottom border of the triangle.

This makes the next breakout important because it could determine whether the recovery extends or reverses.

Additionally, RSI at 46.02 shows XRP is experiencing neutral to slightly downward momentum against strong buying power. Therefore, if the price breaks through $1.54, it will likely be enough to create room for the price to possibly recover back to $1.70 or higher.

A breakthrough below rising support will indicate a weakening setup. Until then, XRP remains caught between tightening resistance and persistent support.

Evernorth tests XRP’s institutional demand

Evernorth’s introduction of a new demand source for XRP’s tightening range. Evernorth plans to list XRP on the Nasdaq exchange. This will put approximately 566 million XRP into a treasury with over $1.1 billion of committed capital backing the treasury.

This is important because institutional capital can provide longer-term support for the demand of XRP to accumulate and potentially counteract short-term trading demand.

Additionally, XRP has unlocked an additional one billion XRP in four batches of 400, 300, 300, and 100 million XRP.

Therefore, the result of these two factors is dependent upon whether most of the newly unlocked XRP makes its way onto exchanges. If so, what percentage of the newly unlocked XRP is absorbed by institutional demand?

Therefore, if Evernorth deploys capital toward XRP while supply remains off exchanges, the demand could support price stability.

Can XRP break $1.54?

The price of XRP continues to be confined within an area that is a contracting structure, with buyer support increasing but seller resistance still present. The price of XRP was able to rise up to $1.665, after which it formed lower highs toward $1.55.

This indicates there is supply present above current levels. The recent 1 billion XRP release by Ripple brings up one additional factor that affects the overall supply of XRP.

A significant portion of each month’s release may return to escrow, thereby limiting the amount of the released coins that are made available for trade.

Therefore, the post-release flow of funds into exchanges is more important than the release itself. Should exchange balances remain under control, then buyers should be able to absorb the current supply of XRP with little or no disruption.

If XRP breaks decisively through the $1.54 resistance level, then this will shift focus to the next resistance level at $1.70. Conversely, if multiple attempts fail to break through the $1.54 level, it is likely to create a stalemate with respect to continuing upward momentum.

Final Summary

  • XRP price tests $1.54, with $1.70 ahead if buyers break resistance.
  • XRP faces Evernorth demand against fresh Ripple supply.

data.title: OriginTrail’s holder count surges to 27,060 ATH – Here’s what it means for TRAC
data.description:
OriginTrail [TRAC] has maintained a bullish outlook, posting a 27% gain in the last 24 hours as bulls dominate market activity.

However, market overvaluation now threatens the bullish outlook and could increase the risk of a decline. Other insights into what’s happening across the asset still hold the potential for the rally to continue and for the market to surge further.

TRAC’s rally shows early signs of a reversal

Chart analysis using technical indicator tools has mapped a path for TRAC, and this time, it’s a road that leads to a decline eventually.

The Bollinger Band assesses whether the market is overvalued or undervalued based on price position. The upper band marks overvaluation, while the lower band marks undervaluation. The indicator now points to a potential decline for TRAC.

The decline is based on the fact that the price has rallied into the upper boundary, and this simply implies there’s likely to be selling pressure that weighs on price, as it historically does, leading to a decline.

One important note is that the Bollinger Band is more of a warning indicator of a possible decline and doesn’t imply that an asset will see an immediate fall. Other factors come into play for the decline to eventually happen.

For now, there’s a high chance that the rally could still hold in the short term, based on the analysis of the Chaikin Money Flow Indicator.

This indicator is used to assess whether there’s buying or selling volume in the market. Based on the reading in the positive region, it suggests there’s been more buying volume.

Right now, that volume is at one of its highest levels, a level, in fact, last seen around the fourth quarter of 2024.

That being the case, there’s a high chance that the price could still witness further upward movement, though the Bollinger Band marks the asset as overvalued.

What to expect is that TRAC is likely to see a further surge before it begins its reversal move eventually.

Rising holders and sentiment support the rally

There’s been a surge in the holder count that supports the bullish narrative, implying that new investors are entering the market.

CoinMarketCap’s Token Holders Count, which tracks on-chain holdings, shows that a total of 27,060 holders are now in the market, a new all-time high reached in the last 24 hours.

Between the 25th of September and press time, that number grew by just 130 holders, 60 of which came in the past day.

This surge in holders translates to growing conviction in an asset’s performance, especially in the near term. What adds more to this is the sentiment in the market staying positively high.

CoinMarketCap noted that the sentiment hit 4.00 in the past day, which, when compared to the scale of -10 to 10, is in a region that bulls can defend.

Sentiment as high as this suggests investors are likely to channel more capital into the asset, buying at a higher premium until the market value eventually normalizes.

Final Summary

  • TRAC’s 27% rally continues as strong buying volume and rising holder count support the bullish momentum.

  • The Bollinger Band warns of potential selling pressure as TRAC trades near the upper boundary.
